reason: E2 directly supports the mechanical and microstructural benefits of uniform TiC dispersion, including hardness, creep, and grain boundary strengthening. E1 supports the feasibility of the proposed processing route (elemental mixing + SPS) for controlled structures, but does not provide evidence that this route specifically achieves uniform TiC dispersion or that inert atmosphere processing mitigates oxidation. The oxidation mitigation premise is thus only partially supported.
premises: Uniformly dispersed TiC in W matrix increases hardness, creep strength, and modulus of elasticity
TiC dispersion at grain boundaries strengthens them and resists grain boundary migration at high temperature
TiC dispersion increases recrystallization temperature and irradiation resistance
Elemental powder mixing + SPS can produce fine-grained material with controlled structure and high density
Controlled inert/reducing atmosphere processing mitigates oxidation
